versions.changelog:
- 更新了 SKILL.md，以说明字体大小、布局和签名块选项。
- 改进了封面、目录和签名块使用的文档。
- 删除了过时的文件：skill-card.md。
- 核心功能和 JavaScript API 没有变动。

Initial release of the IT Integration Solution skill:

- Enables generation of enterprise-grade IT integration solution documents in Word (.docx) format, tailored for professional proposals, technical schemes, and bidding documents.
- Implements full chapter structure following Chinese central SOE/enterprise norms, including cover page, TOC, project overview, requirements, technical design, architecture, implementation, management, training, support, and acceptance.
- Provides strict document formatting: font, size, spacing, heading numbering, and table/image caption styles, all matching enterprise standards.
- Supplies ready-to-use JavaScript API and convenience functions for fast and customizable document creation.
- Comprehensive inline documentation, usage examples, and standardized style naming to ensure precise output and ease of use.
